headline: What comes back.
lede: *Eight questions, hardest first,* each tied to the paragraph it comes from.

items.text: What does the £240k saving assume about headcount?
Why is there no mitigation for supplier failure in the risk table?
What does option B cost? It is recommended without a figure.
Who owns delivery after month three?
What happens to the current contract if we choose this?
Which of the three benefits has a number behind it?
What did the pilot measure, and against what baseline?
